operating_point.platform: CPU; GitHub runners (4 vCPU) for probes, the laptop's light lane for touched tests
operating_point.sizes_and_parameters: the builder's sweep-count draws (a hull kind on a 3.175 mm tube's floor, 1e-9 m above the shrunk wall, linear speed 1e-6 to 5e-2 m/s, angular 1e-3 to 50 rad/s, a load of 0.3 to 3 weights up to 1.4 rad off the normal, mu log-uniform 0.01 to 1.2, dt 1 ms); the declared counts (20 for the sphere, ellipsoid, capsule, cylinder; 80 for the box and FL-9); the reference 4000 sweeps
operating_point.seeds_and_draws: 1000 draws a kind and dtype at seed 101 (the estimate is chosen on these) and 1000 at seed 202 (validated on these, never chosen on them)

gate_b1_unconverged_rate.claim: the true share of held steps whose twist is further than the line from the 4000-sweep solution, in the step's own norm over the hold's whole change, at each kind's declared count
gate_b1_unconverged_rate.case: probe/b1.py through RigidInertialMidpointNode.frictional_held and its iterates (frictional_sweeps from a carried start)

prediction.unit: share of FL-9's held draws past 1e-3 at 80 sweeps (box: 0.01 to 0.04; the four smooth kinds at 20: under 0.002)
prediction.basis: measured-before (review probe B, seed 11: FL-9 0.078, box 0.023, cylinder 0)
prediction.why: the same draws' distribution at other seeds; the screw's crest passes and long levers hold a slow mode the sweeps leave

gate_b1_unconverged_rate.metric: the held twist's distance from the 4000-sweep solution in the step's norm over the hold's whole change: the metric the counts were declared by

control.plant: none: a measurement; the flag below is its control
control.resolution: the reference's own distance from the solution (4000 sweeps), under 1e-6 of the hold's change on all but the box's slowest draws

gate_b1_unconverged_rate.if_wrong: a rate far above 1 % at 80 sweeps is reported to the coordinator before any count is changed (the count's cost is the maintainer's trade)
gate_b1_unconverged_rate.cannot_discriminate_if: the reference is itself unconverged on a draw (it reads that draw's distance short): the box face-down draws, about 1 in 1000

gate_b1_flag.claim: unconverged rises on every held step whose twist is further than the line from its solution, read in the step from the sweeps' last changes (an a-posteriori estimate of the distance still to come)
gate_b1_flag.case: probe/b1.py, and the node's own flag through frictional_held at the declared counts

prediction.unit: held draws past the line with the flag down, per kind and dtype, at the validation seed
prediction.basis: guess (the estimate's form is chosen on seed 101's draws, then judged on seed 202's)
prediction.why: projected Gauss-Seidel's tail converges about linearly once the active set settles, so the last changes and their ratio bound the distance still to come; a ratio near one (stagnation) raises the flag outright

gate_b1_flag.metric: silent draws (past the line, flag down) and false alarms (flag up, within the line) at the validation seed

control.plant: the sweeps cut to a quarter of the declared count: the draws past the line rise and every one must be flagged
control.expected_rate: every draw past the line flagged

gate_b1_flag.if_wrong: a silent draw at the validation seed: the estimate is not a bound; widen it (a factor, or the rate cap) on seed 101 again and validate on a third seed
gate_b1_flag.cannot_discriminate_if: no draw of a kind is past the line at its count (the smooth kinds at 20): the flag is then judged on the cut-count control alone

gate_m1_ledger_sign.claim: friction is booked with its sign (dt sum l . u at the solved twist), and a step where it does positive work beyond rounding on the step's scale is a gift, counted on friction's row and named in the ledger's findings
gate_m1_ledger_sign.case: tests/oracles/test_friction.py's ledger case (a sphere on the tilted tube's floor, metered built.run)

prediction.unit: gift steps on friction's row with the flip planted (100 steps); 0 clean
prediction.basis: derived: a flipped friction does +mu N |u| dt on every sliding step
prediction.why: the flip makes l . u positive at the solved twist on every step the sphere slips

gate_m1_ledger_sign.metric: ledger_gift_steps on friction's row and the run's findings

control.plant: friction's sign flipped in the solve (the review's planted flip)
control.expected_rate: N/N over drawn slopes and coefficients
control.resolution: a push of friction beyond IDENTITY_ULPS eps of the step's scale

gate_m1_ledger_sign.if_wrong: gift_steps stays 0 under the flip: friction's row is not judged as a dissipative law's
gate_m1_ledger_sign.cannot_discriminate_if: the sphere rolls without slipping (no slip, no work either sign): the drawn slopes are past the rolling threshold

gate_m2_normal_law.claim: Contact(normal=...) is refused by name for any law but Hold() (built), and normal_law_suite refuses a law the solve cannot run rather than judging Hold() in its place
gate_m2_normal_law.case: a lab's NormalLaw (the review's Bouncy) through Contact.setting_problems and the build, and normal_law_suite
gate_m2_normal_law.metric: the refusal's text and the suite's status
gate_m2_normal_law.if_wrong: the seam still accepts what it ignores

gate_m3_slip_derivative.claim: contact_slip_speed's derivative in mu and in the slope equals central differences on both sides of the stick threshold (zero sticking)
gate_m3_slip_derivative.case: the block and the sphere on the node's plane, 20 steps, at 0.5, 0.99, 1.01, 2 of the threshold

prediction.unit: d(slip)/dmu, the sphere at 1.001 of the threshold (review's CD); 0 sticking
prediction.why: the slip speed is the norm of the sliding rows' rates, smooth away from zero

gate_m3_slip_derivative.metric: |AD - CD| over the CD's scale, 1e-6 float64, 1e-2 float32

control.plant: the slip taken through stop_gradient (the previous code)
control.resolution: a derivative error of the CD's own rounding

gate_m3_slip_derivative.if_wrong: AD differs from CD sliding: the norm's derivative or the active set's
gate_m3_slip_derivative.cannot_discriminate_if: sticking (AD and CD both zero): the sliding side carries the gate

gate_m4_controls.claim: each gate's control caught on every run over drawn operating points, through detection_rate.py, with its discriminating range from discriminating_range.py
gate_m4_controls.case: probe/gates.py per gate (G1 block, G2 sphere, G5 gradient, G6 off the wall, G8 multi-point, G10 the guard)

prediction.why: each control is planted at ten times its oracle's resolution

gate_m4_controls.metric: caught/N and the clean arm's flagged/N
gate_m4_controls.if_wrong: a control missing a run: plant above its measured resolution, or sharpen the oracle
gate_m4_controls.cannot_discriminate_if: a plant below the oracle's resolution
